changes.before: An arXiv preprint tested 12 coding agent configurations on 186 real-world tasks. The sharpest gap: SWE-Agent with Claude 4 Sonnet solved 57% of tasks correctly, but only 11.8% of those solutions were secure. Adding vulnerability hints to prompts didn't close the gap. Benchmark and dataset are public; run it before shipping agent-written code to production.
changes.after: An arXiv preprint tested 12 coding agent configurations on 186 real-world tasks. The sharpest gap: SWE-Agent with Claude 4 Sonnet solved 57% of tasks correctly, but only 11.8% of those solutions were secure. Adding vulnerability hints to prompts didn't close the gap. Benchmark and dataset are public; the correctness-security gap is now measured, public, and reproducible.
